description: A tube-flavoured overdrive: a squared term that adds even harmonics, then a soft saturation

params.text: Sets the gain into the saturator, multiplying the input by a fifth at its minimum and by 5.2 at its maximum

outputs.text: The saturated signal, stripped of DC and scaled to about ±5V

notes: the three lamps read the level going into the saturator: blue as soon as there is any signal, green from about four tenths of the saturation point, red once that point is passed.
menu: Oversample x2 — runs the saturator at twice the sample rate
Oversample x4 — runs the saturator at four times the sample rate, which is where it starts
Oversample x8 — runs the saturator at eight times the sample rate
